name: Siren MinterAmm withdrawCapital ERC1155 callback reentrancy
summary: MinterAmm.withdrawCapital burned LP and snapshotted the AMM's collateral, then sent the redeemer's ERC1155 option tokens before paying collateral and had no reentrancy guard. The attacker re-entered withdrawCapital from onERC1155Received, so nested withdrawals were priced against a stale collateral balance, draining six Siren Polygon AMMs.

loss.notes: Net collateral each AMM paid to the attack contract, less collateral the attacker supplied in the same transaction, across six exploit transactions. Liquid assets at DefiLlama quotes before each leg; USDC at par; aggregate method other. ERC1155 option tokens are not valued.

ageReset.description: The AMM proxy constructor fixed MinterAmm 0xca84835655a8e863d34875326419a46f823320f6 as its logic; no CodeAddressUpdated occurred before the exploit, so the proxy's creation is when the reentrant withdrawCapital became active for this context. Five sibling AMMs share the runtime and logic.

sources.note: Reviewed anchor, root cause and earliest use. Attacker EOA 0x6004ba8d5fb50b611344e29c19641e734c5f0759 (Etherscan V2 account.txlist chainid=137) creates attack contract 0x685b121bbb80e89c232f0ea1755794f14cfc9822 in 0xc69209cfde02062cc71139e562e37b0c211baddd63da14b415d4db4bc557acd2 (block 18681795), calls setRecipient in 0xc48d3535aa04bc6d181259c0db8a04b1749bbf5f84c95fbaafd789c6f2479d95, then exploit(address) 0x0aeb4ddf once per AMM: source-1 (block 18681881, index 10, UNI AMM 0xc3f7250f458e86a4bd19d0819550ac0b17902bdc) and the five source-2 legs. Its only earlier contract, 0x0435af40048622919f61df78afc23c9354b1d9ca, receives two SetGreeting(string) calls and never touches Siren. debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) of source-1: Aave V2 flashLoan (0x8dff5e27ea6b7ac08ebfdf9eb090f32ee9a30fcf) of WETH, swap to UNI on SushiSwap, bTokenBuy 0xd694fd7c, then repeated provideCapital 0x48257018 / withdrawCapital 0x3b26cf5c on the AMM proxy, which delegatecalls MinterAmm 0xca84835655a8e863d34875326419a46f823320f6. Inside withdrawCapital the AMM burns LP (0x9dc29fac), reads its collateral balance, and transfers the pro-rata ERC1155 option tokens through ERC1155Controller 0x509fe9c9 safeTransferFrom (0xf242432a); the onERC1155Received callback (0xf23a6e61) on the attack contract re-enters withdrawCapital before the outer frame's collateral safeTransfer (0xa9059cbb), so the nested frame divides a collateral balance that still contains the outer share by the already reduced LP supply. Source-4 shows withdrawCapital (lines 336-391) has no reentrancy guard and pays collateral only after _sellOrWithdrawActiveTokens. Source-1 receipt holds 14 LpTokensBurned logs from the UNI AMM. Earliest use: Etherscan getLogs LpTokensBurned(address,uint256,uint256), topic 0xf7f5b08c1cb6009189fe977fb5c4665b4be8a7eff9cb01f0dca3419a1876668b, on all eight factory AMMs (factory 0x0cdaa64b47474e02cdfbd811ec9fd2d265cd3a0a AmmCreated logs from block 17842705) over blocks 17842705..18863568 returns 128 logs; the only transactions with more than one burn are source-1 and the five source-2 legs (14-16 each). The first post-exploit CodeAddressUpdated on every AMM is at block 18863569 or later.

Verified MinterAmm source for 0xca84835655a8e863d34875326419a46f823320f6: Etherscan V2 contract.getsourcecode chainid=137, compiler v0.8.0+commit.c7dfd78e, optimizer 1 run; SHA-256 of the returned SourceCode string (jq -j) 2493fa60618d99dfd63c071acffb6138f0cdc89ba607a145d43245c46c082c16. MinterAmm.sol withdrawCapital (lines 336-391) burns LP, snapshots collateralToken.balanceOf(this), calls _sellOrWithdrawActiveTokens, which calls erc1155Controller.safeTransferFrom to msg.sender, and only then safeTransfers the collateral share; no nonReentrant modifier or ReentrancyGuard exists in the file. Proxy.sol stores the logic address in slot 0xc5f16f0fcc639fa48a6947836d9850f504798523bf8c9a3a87d5876cf622bcf7 in its constructor; Proxiable._updateCodeAddress emits CodeAddressUpdated(address).

Reviewed target identity and age history. UNI AMM proxy 0xc3f7250f458e86a4bd19d0819550ac0b17902bdc: source-5 (block 17844505, index 50) callTracer shows CREATE from AmmFactory 0x0cdaa64b47474e02cdfbd811ec9fd2d265cd3a0a (tx sender 0xacaabb76e70c7a99693e9057e627088f5fec443d); eth_getCode empty at 17844504; runtime keccak 0x812ea6ee43c5ba26392c1d4e43c634f70bbd7ef319c6dae6baa6f28d90de8b0d (130 bytes) at 17844505 and 18681880; logic slot 0xc5f16f0f...bcf7 = 0xca84835655a8e863d34875326419a46f823320f6 at 17844505 and 18681880. Implementation: source-6 top-level creation by 0xacaabb76e70c7a99693e9057e627088f5fec443d at block 17842692 index 50; code empty at 17842691, keccak 0x234194b44ec00ad0e9f8921e2cbf68d9c08a861ff421b84bfde04345afbcea68 (24259 bytes) at 17842692 and 18681880. Etherscan getLogs CodeAddressUpdated(address) (topic 0xeeaed647dc622e55877c30943e5c1d4feb92d1b8cfcc88d974163e9787bde9af) on the proxy, blocks 0..latest: first event at block 18863569 (logic 0x1695d5ef25fd29582ec296ebd7a510ddd71e332a), after the campaign. The logic was therefore fixed by the proxy constructor and first became active for this execution context at source-5, which supplies the age; the implementation's own deployment 1813 blocks earlier is not an activation. Sibling AMMs 0x41667758d84c1a6c89e4422fce6453bb376ddb8d (WMATIC), 0xb54dfba46af632e865c3cec53f4e631307fa22ef (WETH), 0xa42e6396c4a66c764d5e86f1ba6b68c3b6427f64 (USDC), 0xa77c6917b2399cb99391f7ce32a4d9658de6ae4e (SUSHI) and 0xb16bfebfbebf7b5f91bf04782b1eaaeeb400b9d4 (KNC), exploited by source-2, carry the same proxy runtime hash and the same logic slot at block 18681880, with no pre-exploit CodeAddressUpdated; they were created by the same factory between blocks 17843784 and 17845181 and are represented by this target.

Reviewed loss. For source-1 and each source-2 leg, eth_getTransactionReceipt Transfer logs of the AMM's collateral token between the AMM and attack contract 0x685b121bbb80e89c232f0ea1755794f14cfc9822: collateral received from the AMM minus collateral the attacker supplied through bTokenBuy and provideCapital in the same transaction. Net AMM depletion: UNI AMM 11994626582474473297679 (UNI 0xb33eaad8d922b1083446dc23f610c2567fb5180f, source-1); WMATIC AMM 266708267659921701393020 (0xd1ed14df..., block 18681916); WETH AMM 267757202647545648190 (0xf0db4f27..., block 18682056); USDC AMM 689082501601 (6 dp, 0x9bb445ab..., block 18682123); SUSHI AMM 50958528701762318769092 (0x0b3f868e0be5597d5db7feb59e1cadbb0fdda50a, 0xc923989a..., block 18682218); KNC AMM 185391612935650503091321 (0x1c954e8fe737f99f68fa1ccda3e51ebdb291948c, 0xc933a8b4..., block 18682379). decimals() is 18 for all but USDC (6). Flash-loan principal and fees, SushiSwap legs and ERC1155 option tokens moved in either direction are not counted, so the figure is net collateral depletion of the six AMMs' LPs. Each asset is valued at the latest DefiLlama quote at or before its leg.
